title: Naturally Smoky Venezuelan Rice Paella
description: A charred and aerated solo dinner dish featuring paella rice and ferment jang, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium high heat.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the paella rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in the oil and spice mixture.
Add the ferment jang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the garlic infused oil and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
